message.text: I should verify that webhook delivery relies on an in-process Go channel rather than external message queues like NATS or RabbitMQ, and check the codebase to confirm there's no usage of those systems.

args.command: cd /bench/repo && grep -rli "nats\|rabbitmq\|amqp" --include="*.go" go.mod go.sum . 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules
